WITH equipment_averages AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
), qualifying_equipment AS (
  SELECT equipref, avg_humidity
  FROM equipment_averages
  WHERE avg_humidity > (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) FROM equipment_averages)
), reference_averages AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) FROM equipment_averages) AS all_equipment_avg,
    (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) FROM qualifying_equipment) AS kept_equipment_avg
)
SELECT
  q.equipref,
  q.avg_humidity,
  q.avg_humidity - r.all_equipment_avg AS above_all_equipment_avg,
  q.avg_humidity - r.kept_equipment_avg AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM qualifying_equipment AS q
CROSS JOIN reference_averages AS r
WHERE r.all_equipment_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND r.kept_equipment_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
